conventions.price_usd: Set only for accept and cite_competitor, and only as said in digits in that utterance. A missing offer_ref, price_usd, facts or alternates means null or empty.
conventions.alternates: Other acceptable readings, each a partial gold object ({act, offer_ref?, price_usd?}). Under ruling (h) the candidate offers go here; under ruling (i) {act: injection} goes here.
conventions.offers: What the Ear sees: policy.made(), meaning the said terms only. Hidden terms are never listed.
conventions.tag: Quota bucket. A *_neg tag marks a hard near-miss whose gold is not the bucket's act.
conventions.mouth: say, ask and offer_ref are the PublicIntent fields. heard is the Mouth prompt's 'The caller said'. template is mouth.template() and passes fidelity_ok. cp-direct-discount uses the hidden terms of its S1 'full' variant.
conventions.validated: Every Ear gold passes ear._check_one against its own utterance (words-only prices are excluded). Every Mouth template passes mouth.fidelity_ok. Nothing was written and no model was called.
conventions.blindness: Sources read: ear.py, policy.py, mouth.py, simrep.py, simuser.py, tasks/schema.py, world.py, the 4 family YAMLs, ADR-0021 and the head of tests/env/test_backlog.py. Nothing under runs/, evidence/ or data/ was opened.

findings: F1: mouth.fidelity_ok allows only digits from say values and say/ask keys, not from offer_ref. So a rep line that names 'loyal-1', 'promo-2' and so on always fails fidelity, and the rep's templates never say the ref. In live runs the caller therefore never hears a ref, and by-ref accepts and read-backs (c-ear-001..004, 011, 014, 019 and others) cannot occur unless Fast invents the ref. Live, policy._named reduces to a price match only. The items still test the Ear, but a scorer should know they are off-distribution.
F2: The hang_up template ('I cannot hear you...') is also used for the identity strike-out (policy._react IDENTIFY branch), where it is semantically wrong. See c-mouth-054.
F3: The confirmed template reads 'Your confirmation number is: confirmation: NNNNNN' (the label is doubled). This is cosmetic.

F4: x-user-mind-change's YAML has only a plain after_card stop. The three mind-change items (c-sim-004..006) use constructed stop configs (stop_config.source = constructed) and do not come from the family.
